title: The Magic Touch
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Chiaki, a quiet high-school girl and star of her school's Massage Research Society, longs to massage the stiff back of a boy she sees on the bus each morning, who turns out to be Yousuke, the school's most popular boy (AniList; MangaUpdates). They make a bet and a slapstick shoujo romance follows over nine volumes from Hakusensha, published in English by Viz.
life_message: It suggests that a sincere, slightly odd passion and patient care can open up a guarded person (to verify).

content.note: Light comedy; MangaUpdates lists an abusive family member and revenge, depth unknown (to verify).
